description: This file defines a WPF/XAML user control for a unit converter in a calculator application, including UI event handlers, state management, and interaction with view models.

classes.name: Activatable
classes.description: A simple view model class implementing IActivatable, managing an active state with getter and setter functions.

classes.name: UnitConverter
classes.description: A sealed partial class representing a user control for unit conversion, handling UI interactions, state management, and data binding.

methods.name: AnimateConverter
methods.description: Triggers an animation if UI animations are enabled.

methods.name: SetDefaultFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to the first available control in a predefined order.

methods.name: OnValueKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events, specifically space key to select a value.

methods.name: OnContextRequested
methods.description: Handles context menu requests, showing a flyout at the pointer position.

methods.name: OnContextCanceled
methods.description: Hides the context menu flyout.

methods.name: OnCopyMenuItemClicked
methods.description: Copies the selected calculation result to clipboard.

methods.name: OnPasteMenuItemClicked
methods.description: Handles paste operation asynchronously, updating the model.

methods.name: OnValueSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of a value control, updating text state and activating the view model.

methods.name: UpdateDropDownState
methods.description: Updates the dropdown open state in the view model based on UI controls.

methods.name: OnLoaded
methods.description: Empty handler for control load event.

methods.name: CurrencyRefreshButton_Click
methods.description: Triggers currency ratio refresh if not already loading, with network considerations.

methods.name: OnPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles property change notifications to update UI states accordingly.

methods.name: OnDataContextChanged
methods.description: Reattaches property changed event handler when data context changes.

methods.name: OnIsDisplayVisibleChanged
methods.description: Updates visual states based on currency data loading and category status.

methods.name: Units1_IsEnabledChanged
methods.description: Sets default focus when units control becomes enabled.

methods.name: OnNetworkBehaviorChanged
methods.description: Adjusts UI based on current network access behavior.

methods.name: OnNormalNetworkAccess
methods.description: Configures UI for normal network operation.

methods.name: OnOptInNetworkAccess
methods.description: Configures UI for opt-in network operation, possibly showing charges.

methods.name: OnOfflineNetworkAccess
methods.description: Configures UI for offline mode.

methods.name: InitializeOfflineStatusTextBlock
methods.description: Sets up offline status text with hyperlink, parsing resource string.

methods.name: SetNormalCurrencyStatus
methods.description: Clears currency status message.

methods.name: SetChargesMayApplyStatus
methods.description: Displays charges warning state.

methods.name: SetFailedToRefreshStatus
methods.description: Displays failure message for currency refresh.

methods.name: SetCurrencyTimestampFontWeight
methods.description: Updates timestamp font weight based on data freshness.

methods.name: StartProgressRingWithDelay
methods.description: Starts a delayed progress indicator for currency loading.

methods.name: OnDelayTimerTick
methods.description: Activates progress ring after delay.

methods.name: HideProgressRing
methods.description: Stops the progress indicator.

methods.name: SupplementaryResultsPanelInGrid_SizeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts layout height based on size changes.

methods.name: OnVisualStateChanged
methods.description: Logs visual state changes for analytics.
